question: Can you provide the top 9 directors by movie count, including their ID, name, number of movies, average inter-movie duration (rounded to the nearest integer), average rating (rounded to 2 decimals), total votes, minimum and maximum ratings, and total movie duration? Sort the output first by movie count in descending order and then by total movie duration in descending order.

prediction.sql:
WITH director_movies AS (
  SELECT
    dm.name_id,
    m.id AS movie_id,
    m.date_published,
    m.duration
  FROM director_mapping dm
  JOIN movies m ON m.id = dm.movie_id
),
inter_movie_gaps AS (
  SELECT
    name_id,
    (julianday(date_published) - julianday(LAG(date_published) OVER (PARTITION BY name_id ORDER BY date_published))) AS gap_days
  FROM director_movies
),
inter_movie_agg AS (
  SELECT
    name_id,
    AVG(gap_days) AS avg_inter_movie_duration
  FROM inter_movie_gaps
  WHERE gap_days IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY name_id
),
movie_agg AS (
  SELECT
    name_id,
    COUNT(*) AS movie_count,
    SUM(duration) AS total_movie_duration
  FROM director_movies
  GROUP BY name_id
),
rating_agg AS (
  SELECT
    dm.name_id,
    AVG(r.avg_rating) AS avg_rating,
    SUM(r.total_votes) AS total_votes,
    MIN(r.avg_rating) AS min_rating,
    MAX(r.avg_rating) AS max_rating
  FROM director_mapping dm
  JOIN ratings r ON r.movie_id = dm.movie_id
  GROUP BY dm.name_id
)
SELECT
  n.id AS director_id,
  n.name AS director_name,
  ma.movie_count,
  ROUND(ia.avg_inter_movie_duration) AS avg_inter_movie_duration,
  ROUND(ra.avg_rating, 2) AS avg_rating,
  ra.total_votes,
  ra.min_rating,
  ra.max_rating,
  ma.total_movie_duration
FROM movie_agg ma
JOIN names n ON n.id = ma.name_id
LEFT JOIN inter_movie_agg ia ON ia.name_id = ma.name_id
LEFT JOIN rating_agg ra ON ra.name_id = ma.name_id
ORDER BY ma.movie_count DESC, ma.total_movie_duration DESC
LIMIT 9;

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
SELECT dm.name_id, n.name, COUNT(*) AS movie_count,
  ROUND(AVG(m.duration)) AS avg_inter_movie_duration,
  ROUND(AVG(r.avg_rating),2) AS avg_rating,
  SUM(r.total_votes) AS total_votes,
  MIN(r.avg_rating) AS min_rating,
  MAX(r.avg_rating) AS max_rating,
  SUM(m.duration) AS total_duration
FROM director_mapping dm
JOIN names n ON n.id = dm.name_id
JOIN movies m ON m.id = dm.movie_id
JOIN ratings r ON r.movie_id = dm.movie_id
GROUP BY dm.name_id, n.name
ORDER BY movie_count DESC, total_duration DESC
LIMIT 9;
